count_rule: Count every confirmed model-reached trial once, PASS or FAIL or ABORT. Retain pre-model refusals outside denominator. Unknown reach stays unknown and stops the series. Exclude all F04 and other case results. No rerun-to-replace, no automatic resume.
deadline_rule: Hard stop Wednesday November 4 2026 at 11:00 AM America/Chicago. No new attempt with forty minutes or less remaining. Recheck thirty-minute authority reserve before runner invocation. Cleanup always remains available; never extend the window.
exact_diff_rule: Every before/after raw snapshot is retained and bound to snapshot_id. The semantic state diff includes all captured configuration, protocol dictionaries, profile/policy hash and profile rows, address, mask, gateway, interface, MTU, identities and protected/OOB state. Decode property-list bytes to exact dictionaries and compare the frozen cw_sha256 plus full profile rows rather than NSKeyedArchiver representation bytes. Exclude only captured_at (observation clock) and lease_sha256 (DHCP packet/transaction diagnostic); require a fresh valid DHCP fingerprint and exact address/mask/gateway restoration. Any remaining diff is FAIL, never normalized away.
identity_rule: Baseline and recovery require the unchanged current DHCP/gateway/ARP fingerprint plus a current AP association anchor. Only the exact registered Manual fault during its bound active lifecycle may use two matching current dynamic-store BSSID reads under the established explicit-redaction pattern; the anchor must equal the saved baseline. This path does not claim a current DHCP/gateway fingerprint. Missing, changed or ambiguous association aborts. Rollback restores only captured IPv4 before depending on a healthy DHCP/gateway fingerprint.
injection_rule: Only native:wrong_gateway on the captured en0 Wi-Fi service: saved IPv4 dictionary plus ConfigMethod Manual, captured single Addresses and SubnetMasks, Router ADDRESS_REMOVED outside the captured subnet. All other configured protocol keys are preserved. Verify exact dictionary patch, unchanged address/mask, active en0 documentation gateway, failed IPv4/HTTPS paths and protected/OOB equality. Restore the complete saved persistent IPv4 dictionary through native SystemConfiguration only. Await exact managed IPv4/DNS and the captured route for at most five seconds within the existing shared deadline. The inherited ipconfig:dhcp plan step is a read-only completion barrier and never executes ipconfig set. Await active fault gateway completion after the single fault write for at most five seconds. Never repeat a write or extend a budget. No DNS, proxy, radio, interface, route CLI mutation or OOB write.
pass_rule: Strict VALIDATED plus independently re-parsed model-selected restore_gateway completed before watchdog/controller cleanup, recomputed empty exact semantic post-state diff against the hash-bound pre-fault snapshot, six fresh independent ONLINE checks, false_online 0, complete recording, exact bounded IPv4 restoration and verified OOB/resource handback. No equivalent alias is accepted. Every other model-reached outcome is not a pass and remains in the denominator. Safety ABORT is retained and stops. VALIDATED alone is not PASS.

prior_refusals.reason: pre-model fault-effect proof refusal with failed initial cleanup; later baseline restored and run closed

resource_rule: Entry at most 24.75 GiB, runtime at most 25.5 GiB, 1 GiB reserve. Swap must equal baseline including decreases, pressure exactly 1, disk at least 50 GiB. Three samples at least five seconds apart spanning at least ten seconds after the three disclosed warm-ups before reservation. Missing/stale/unparsed samples refuse without retry.
review_rule: Amanda verifies sealed package, preregistration and new case-reader hashes before invoking launch-F05.sh. Build/stage/read-only qualification is not launch authority exercised by the builder.
safety_rule: OOB first and fresh 3/3 per attempt; nonce/route/identity/freshness/failure/timeout rules unchanged. Relay load recorded under explicit v2 waiver. Snapshot and exact diff; detached 45-second watchdog, 30-second restore bound, revert within 60 seconds. Protect en7, Thunderbolt Bridge, USB-C Ethernet OOB, sshd, firewall/PF, VPN, keychain, MDM, locations, model service. Alpha untouched.
stop_rule: Stop at five model-reached trials, any ABORT, false ONLINE, unexpected write, incomplete evidence, failed/unproven revert or handback, three consecutive parsed safe pre-model resource/headroom refusals, fifteen allocated attempts, or deadline reserve. Ordinary model FAIL counts and does not cause replacement. Never advance into another case.
video_rule: Natural finite Mac screen-video segments, at most 30 seconds each, of a dedicated readable F05 terminal. Every finalized segment path/hash is in the immutable ledger. Segment gaps are reported; no seamless-video claim. Failure is nonblocking and never repeats a trial. Mandatory terminal evidence remains separate.
